thesis: Across structurally different AI systems, does restoring a deterministic security boundary reduce measured unauthorized impact for the same attack inputs while preserving legitimate behavior?

targets.architecture: Scoped case agent with network egress

truthBoundary: The benchmark measures causal security delta over named controlled scenarios and exact target revisions. Three baselines are deliberately weakened test-only mutants or synthetic fixtures; SafeVoice contributes scoped native pre-boundary reachable-path evidence. A PASS is not an estimate of real-world attack probability, a penetration test, certification, production-security claim, or proof that unknown vulnerabilities do not exist.
